facts.business: Triochem Products Limited disposed of its manufacturing property, plant and equipment and ceased manufacturing operations; the company has not generated operating revenue for the current and preceding years and is evaluating alternative business opportunities.
key_risks: Going concern risk due to cessation of manufacturing operations and no operating revenue; dependence on liquidity (cash and liquid investments of Rs 1,961.73 lakh) and evaluation of alternative business opportunities
facts.related_party_note: All transactions entered into with Related Parties during the financial year were in the ordinary course of business and on arm's length basis.
